_doc: vEcoli (v1) workflow config for the MATCHED 16x16 equivalence reference of the showcase-6-equivalence-large study. Run with vEcoli's own Nextflow workflow (`python -m runscripts.workflow --config <this>`) from the in-repo sibling vEcoli checkout (CovertLab/vEcoli @ b237873e). Produces a hive-partitioned parquet sweep (**/history/**/*.pq) at the SAME 16 seeds x 16 generations as the v2 measured side. The resulting sweep is consumed by scripts/pin_vecoli_equivalence_reference.py (--sweep-dir, --gen-lb 3) to pin docs/report_cards/population_phenotype_basal/vs_vecoli/vecoli_reference.json. sim_data_path reuses a prebuilt full ParCa (out/kb/simData.cPickle) so the workflow skips the ParCa rebuild. Basal/minimal-glucose condition, single_daughters lineage from seed 0, per-generation cap 3600 s (matches the v2 population_phenotype_basal_16x16 config); cells divide naturally well before the cap.
